title: Tasks
description: Phase 3 task breakdown maintained by Dev.

issue_number.description: Tracker issue number. Accepts a string for an experiment run (/pipeline --dry-run), which uses an exp-<slug> placeholder instead of opening a tracker issue, and null before an id exists.

experiment_id.description: Present only on an experiment run: the exp-<slug> placeholder id used in place of a tracker issue.

satisfiability_proof.description: QA's Phase 3a satisfiability record (#158), architectural tier. Written by QA into tasks.json before it returns: whether a throwaway reference implementation took the contract green (reference_impl_run), which criteria it proved (criteria_proven), which it could not and why (criteria_unproven), and every test config or pool the committed files run under (configs_run). The SubagentStop validator refuses a QA stop at the architectural tier when this block is absent or carries neither list; the orchestrator halts before dispatching Dev on the same condition.
